ESAT Mock Practice — Bingkun Qi

A mock-practice project for ESAT, connecting admissions-test preparation with science teaching tools.

About this project

Alongside course question banks, I am interested in the practice needs that come with admissions tests. The ESAT mock practice project is an exploration in that direction.

My aim is to combine my experience teaching science and mathematics with tool development, giving an idea for exam preparation a practical form.

Features and use cases

  • Focused on ESAT preparation
  • Designed around mock practice
